decision: Stopped before committing on story/19-chatbot-latest-dependencies due to upstream sibling cohort blockers under targets-20261127.json. Release build succeeds (0 errors, 0 ChatBot warnings, 6 upstream Platform CS0618 Aspire 17 deprecation warnings allowed via WarningsNotAsErrors), 13/14 core test suites plus NativeReviewQueueTests and test_require_runtime.py pass 100% (6,729 passed, 0 failed), and all 4 EventStore domain owners (tenants, parties, projects, chatbot) clear owner preparation after ChatBot composition/harness updates. However, two frozen-cohort upstream blockers prevent green Architecture, Live, and Release gates without editing sibling repos, changing targets-20261127.json SHAs, or weakening assertions: (1) EventStore 5484fae6 (v5.6.0-67) adds ResultPayloadOmissionReason to SubmitCommandResponse (commit 360ed041d), causing eventstore's ObservedRouteCatalogHost to reject catalog.json built against published EventStore 5.6.0; (2) FrontComposer b3342381 (commit adcc8b32) and Parties ca637a01 (commit ea6c6fd2) override Builds v6.8.5 catalog versions in their Directory.Packages.props, failing ScaffoldArchitectureTests.RootDeclaredSiblingPackageWrappersShouldDelegateVersionsToSharedBuildsCatalog. A disposable diagnostic probe with EventStore archived at v5.6.0 (295b5a6b) cleared catalog commit across all 5 hosts and passed CorrectionPropagationWorkflowRuntimeShouldBeHealthyInRealDaprTopology, while surfacing a third cohort runtime issue in Memories 830484ee tenant provisioning workflow (FAILED) and HTTP timeouts under concurrent host load. No ChatBot commit, push, remote fetch, sibling edit, registration, or adoption occurred.
method: Standalone package-mode Release copies under run-with-temp populated from /home/administrator/projects/hexalith/chatbot-story-19-latest plus git archive of all 16 references/* from CiCd's local object stores at targets-20261127.json SHAs. Serialized MSBuild (-m:1 /nr:false, matching ChatBot ci.yml) to avoid MSB3026/MSB4018 file locks on multi-path project outputs. No remote fetches, no nested submodule initialization, no sibling edits.

blockers.summary: targets-20261127.json pins references/Hexalith.EventStore to 5484fae6 (v5.6.0-67), where commit 360ed041d added ResultPayloadOmissionReason to SubmitCommandResponse. In package mode, AppHost (Hexalith.EventStore.Aspire 5.6.0) and prepared owners generate catalog.json operation digests from published EventStore.Contracts 5.6.0 (295b5a6b, 3 properties), while the source-built eventstore executable compiles EventStore.Contracts from 5484fae6 (4 properties). ObservedRouteCatalogHost.ObserveAsync:109 refuses the catalog with 'The installed owner operation schemas or eligibility differ from the proposed generation.' Proved by disposable probe at v5.6.0 (295b5a6b), which immediately committed eventstore.committed.json across all 5 hosts.
resolution_options: Release a new Hexalith.EventStore package carrying 360ed041d and promote Hexalith.Builds catalog to it.
Approve pinning references/Hexalith.EventStore to v5.6.0 (295b5a6ba584167f21cfef40787477b8814e32da) so the source executable matches Builds v6.8.5's published 5.6.0 SDK.
